verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["is hereby authorized"],"text":"(a) The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of \nthe Treasury and other officials of the United States Government as appro-\npriate, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign person any of the sanctions \ndescribed in subsections (b) and (c) of this section, upon determining that \nthe person, on or after the date of this order: \n(i) is responsible for or complicit in, has directly or indirectly engaged \nin, or attempted to engage in, or financed the obstruction, disruption, \nor prevention of efforts to promote a Syria that is stable, unified, and \nat peace with itself and its neighbors, including: \n(A) the convening and conduct of a credible and inclusive Syrian- \nled constitutional process; \n(B) the preparation for and conduct of supervised elections, pursuant \nto the new constitution, that are free and fair and to the highest inter-\nnational standards of transparency and accountability; or \n(C) the development of a Syrian government that is representative and \nreflects the will of the Syrian people; \n(ii) is an adult family member of a person designated under subsection \n(a)(i) of this section; or \n(iii) is responsible for or complicit in, or has directly or indirectly engaged \nin, or attempted to engage in, the expropriation of property, including \nreal property, for personal gain or political purposes in Syria.’’"},{"char_end":11336,"char_start":10842,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":11336,"context_char_start":10842,"line":160,"pdf_page":3,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary \nof the Treasury, shall examine whether the criteria set forth in section \n7431(a) of the Caesar Act have been met, and on the basis of that examination \nmay, pursuant to the Presidential Memorandum of March 31, 2020 (Delega-\ntion of Certain Functions and Authorities Under the National Defense Author-\nization Act for Fiscal Year 2020), suspend in whole or in part the imposition \nof sanctions otherwise required under the Caesar Act."},{"char_end":11675,"char_start":11337,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":11675,"context_char_start":11337,"line":166,"pdf_page":3,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"If the Secretary of \nState determines to suspend in whole or in part the imposition of such \nsanctions, the Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the \nTreasury, shall provide the briefing to the appropriate congressional commit-\ntees required by section 7431(b) of the Caesar Act within 30 days of such \ndetermination."},{"char_end":12023,"char_start":11676,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":12023,"context_char_start":11676,"line":171,"pdf_page":3,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall","shall"],"text":"Further, the Secretary of State, in consultation with the Sec-\nretary of the Treasury, shall continue to review the situation in Syria, and \nif the Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, \ndetermines that the criteria set forth in section 7431(a) are no longer met, \nthe Secretary of State shall reimpose sanctions."},{"char_end":12541,"char_start":12409,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":12541,"context_char_start":12409,"line":181,"pdf_page":3,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["is hereby authorized"],"text":"(a) The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of \nthe Treasury and other officials of the United States Government as appro-\npriate, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign person any of the sanctions \ndescribed in subsections (b) and (c) of this section, upon determining that \nthe person, on or after the date of this order: \n(i) is responsible for or complicit in, has directly or indirectly engaged \nin, or attempted to engage in, or financed the obstruction, disruption, \nor prevention of efforts to promote a Syria that is stable, unified, and \nat peace with itself and its neighbors, including: \n(A) the convening and conduct of a credible and inclusive Syrian- \nled constitutional process; \n(B) the preparation for and conduct of supervised elections, pursuant \nto the new constitution, that are free and fair and to the highest inter-\nnational standards of transparency and accountability; or \n(C) the development of a Syrian government that is representative and \nreflects the will of the Syrian people; \n(ii) is an adult family member of a person designated under subsection \n(a)(i) of this section; or \n(iii) is responsible for or complicit in, or has directly or indirectly engaged \nin, or attempted to engage in, the expropriation of property, including \nreal property, for personal gain or political purposes in Syria.’’"},{"char_end":11336,"char_start":10842,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":11336,"context_char_start":10842,"line":160,"pdf_page":3,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary \nof the Treasury, shall examine whether the criteria set forth in section \n7431(a) of the Caesar Act have been met, and on the basis of that examination \nmay, pursuant to the Presidential Memorandum of March 31, 2020 (Delega-\ntion of Certain Functions and Authorities Under the National Defense Author-\nization Act for Fiscal Year 2020), suspend in whole or in part the imposition \nof sanctions otherwise required under the Caesar Act."},{"char_end":11675,"char_start":11337,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":11675,"context_char_start":11337,"line":166,"pdf_page":3,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"If the Secretary of \nState determines to suspend in whole or in part the imposition of such \nsanctions, the Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the \nTreasury, shall provide the briefing to the appropriate congressional commit-\ntees required by section 7431(b) of the Caesar Act within 30 days of such \ndetermination."},{"char_end":12023,"char_start":11676,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":12023,"context_char_start":11676,"line":171,"pdf_page":3,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall","shall"],"text":"Further, the Secretary of State, in consultation with the Sec-\nretary of the Treasury, shall continue to review the situation in Syria, and \nif the Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, \ndetermines that the criteria set forth in section 7431(a) are no longer met, \nthe Secretary of State shall reimpose sanctions."},{"char_end":12541,"char_start":12409,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":12541,"context_char_start":12409,"line":181,"pdf_page":3,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Secretary of State shall submit to the appropriate congressional \ncommittees the report required under section 5(b) of that Act."},{"char_end":13992,"char_start":13804,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":13992,"context_char_start":13804,"line":202,"pdf_page":4,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"(b) The Secretary of State shall transmit this waiver determination and \nreport as required by sections 307(d)(1)(B) and (d)(2) of the CBW Act to \nthe appropriate congressional committees."},{"char_end":14066,"char_start":13993,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":14066,"context_char_start":13993,"line":204,"pdf_page":4,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"This waiver shall be effective \n20 days after it has been so transmitted."},{"char_end":14645,"char_start":14107,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":14645,"context_char_start":14107,"line":206,"pdf_page":4,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"(a) The Secretary of State, in consulta-\ntion with the Secretary of the Treasury and the Attorney General, shall \ntake all appropriate action with respect to the designation of al-Nusrah \nFront, also known as Hay’at Tahrir al-Sham and other aliases, as a Foreign \nTerrorist Organization under 8 U.S.C. 1189 and as a Specially Designated \nGlobal Terrorist under 50 U.S.C. 1702 and Executive Order 13224, as well \nas the designation of Abu Muhammad al-Jawlani, commonly known as \nAhmed al-Sharaa, as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist."},{"char_end":15111,"char_start":14647,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":15111,"context_char_start":14647,"line":214,"pdf_page":4,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"(b) The Secretary of State shall take all appropriate action to review \nthe designation of Syria as a State Sponsor of Terrorism consistent with \nsection 1754(c) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year \n2019 (Public Law 115–232; 50 U.S.C. 4813(c)), section 40 of the Arms \nExport Control Act (Public Law 90–629, as amended; 22 U.S.C. 2780), and \nsection 620A of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 (Public Law 87–195, \nas amended; 22 U.S.C. 2371)."},{"char_end":15491,"char_start":15137,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":15491,"context_char_start":15137,"line":221,"pdf_page":4,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Secretary of State shall take appropriate steps \nto advance United States policy objectives at the United Nations to support \na Syria that is stable and at peace and to support Syrian efforts to counter \nterrorism and comply with its responsibilities and obligations concerning \nweapons of mass destruction, including chemical and biological weapons."},{"char_end":15899,"char_start":15664,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":15899,"context_char_start":15664,"line":228,"pdf_page":4,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["are hereby authorized"],"text":"The Secretary of State, the Secretary of the Treasury, \nand the Secretary of Commerce, as appropriate, are hereby authorized to \ntake such actions, including adopting rules and regulations, as may be \nnecessary to implement this order."},{"char_end":16466,"char_start":16094,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":16466,"context_char_start":16094,"line":234,"pdf_page":4,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory;
